instruction: Please act as a professional verilog designer. Implement a module that accumulates input data serially and outputs the accumulated result whenever the module receives 8 input data. The input and output interfaces should use the valid-ready two-way handshake mechanism to interact with the upstream and downstream. The module should be designed using a counter-based architecture, which counts the number of input data received and triggers the output when the count reaches 8. The module should be optimized to avoid any bubbles in data transmission and minimize performance loss due to the design.
